ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: Figure 1-3 is a schematic diagram of the material cycle of the lithosphere. In the figure, the lower right is D; D follows an upward arrow to A in the upper right, and beside the arrow is marked “condensation”; A follows a leftward arrow to B in the upper left, marked “sedimentation”; B follows a downward arrow to C in the lower left, marked “metamorphism”; C follows a rightward arrow to D, marked “melting”. Then reason: From “condensation”, it can be judged that D is magma; magma condenses to form A, so A is magmatic rock. A forms B through “sedimentation”, so B is sedimentary rock. B forms C through “metamorphism”, so C belongs to metamorphic rock. Among common rocks, marble belongs to metamorphic rock, therefore C in the figure indicates marble.
